subject: Day-of: candidate positive test — convert in-person loop to asynchronous/code take-home?
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@talentco.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate Ethan Zhou — on-site loop confirmed for Tue 10 Jun 10:00 PT

Hi team,

Quick confirmation: Ethan Zhou (resume attached) will be on-site for the backend loop tomorrow, Tue 10 Jun at 10:00 PT. Visiting from SFO office — he asked for a 10:00 start. Panel: Diego (infra), Monica (bar-raiser), Grace (interview ops).

Candidate contact: ezhou@email.com / (415) 555-0123.

Attaching resume for your reference. Let me know if anything needs to shift.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Singh | TalentCo
Attachment: resume_ezhou.pdf (PDF, 38KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@talentco.io>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate Ethan Zhou — on-site loop confirmed for Tue 10 Jun 10:00 PT

Thanks Maya — got it.

Monica / Grace: see you tomorrow at 9:45 for quick sync. Planning a 50-60m deep design + 40m system design + 30m behavioral.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Staff Software Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Zhou <ezhou@email.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya@talentco.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent — tested positive today, request for alternative format

Hi Diego / Monica / Grace,

Really sorry to be writing at the last minute. I just tested positive for COVID this morning (rapid test) and am symptomatic with a low-grade fever. I don’t want to risk coming into the office or exposing the team.

Would it be possible to convert tomorrow’s in-person loop to either: 1) a take-home coding task (48–72 hour window) plus a follow-up 30m async video/code walk, or 2) record the interview remotely and submit afterwards? I can do the take-home quickly — I want to make sure I’m still in process.

I apologize for the disruption and appreciate any flexibility. Happy to provide the test photo if needed.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Zhou
Senior Backend Engineer Candidate
Attachment: rapid-test-photo.jpg (image, 120KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@talentco.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Urgent — tested positive today, request for alternative format

Diego / Grace — thanks for the heads-up, Ethan.

Options that keep schedule fairness:
- Convert to a take-home coding exercise (we provide instructions + 48 hours). Panel reviews submission asynchronously, then we schedule a 30m live code-walk (video) if needed.
- Or convert to a remote recorded interview; panelers can pre-record (not ideal).

I recommend take-home + 30m follow-up to preserve the assessment shape. We should offer a $150 courtesy for the day-of disruption (standard recruiter play) and cover any travel expenses he may have already incurred (fills out expense-form.pdf).

Grace — can you draft the take-home instructions and expense form link? I can send candidate the conversion confirmation.

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Zhou <ezhou@email.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@talentco.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 14:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent — tested positive today, request for alternative format

Ethan — thanks for letting us know and totally understand. Hope you feel better soon.

We're happy to convert tomorrow's on-site loop to a take-home coding exercise + short live video walk. Proposed plan: 
- We'll email you a take-home instructions PDF and a starter repo link today.
- 48 hours to complete (drop deadline: Wed 11 Jun 14:00 PT).
- Panel reviews asynchronously; Diego/Monica/Grace will reserve a 30m sync slot Fri 13 Jun 11:00 PT in case we need a follow-up.
- We'll offer a $150 courtesy payment for the day-of change and reimburse reasonable travel expenses — please fill and return the attached expense-form.pdf.

Attachment: takehome-instructions.pdf (PDF, 14KB)
Attachment: expense-form.pdf (PDF, 6KB)

From: Ethan Zhou <ezhou@email.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya@talentco.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent — tested positive today, request for alternative format

Diego / Monica / Grace — thank you, that plan works for me and I appreciate the flexibility.

I received the instructions and expense form. I’ll aim to have the exercise in by Wed 14:00 PT; if I need a tiny extension I’ll flag it. I’ve attached the test photo here.

Thanks again for accommodating — I look forward to the take-home.

Best,
Ethan
Attachment: rapid-test-photo.jpg (image, 120KB)
